data.name: Dafeenah
data.gender_notes: Dafeenah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'dafa', meaning 'to strike'. Dafeenah symbolizes softness, tenderness, and gentleness, reflecting the nurturing and compassionate nature of a mother in Islamic culture. The name Dafeenah carries the meaning “Soft, tender, gentle” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Dafeenah usually hope their child will grow to embody soft, tender, gentle and live with faith, good character and purpose.
